title: Asymmetric Repository Lineage Modeling and Verifier-Guided Coordination in Concurrent AI Coding Agents
title_zh: 非对称仓库谱系建模与并发AI编码智能体中的验证器引导协调

paragraphs.en: Concurrent AI coding agents create a coordination problem in which cheap signals may prioritize work, but only an executable checker can establish the property being claimed. We study this separation through a property-scoped verification contract and MergeGym , a three-track benchmark for open-time scope forecasting, replay-conditioned conflict resolution, and scheduling. On a stratified 715-pair lineage set (167 textual conflicts), 79 conflicts (47.3%) occur despite disjoint authored file sets. This is an operationally important proxy mismatch expected from three-way merge : authored PR diffs are measured against PR-specific bases, whereas the checker compares both heads to their common merge base. A standalone lineage-union rule reaches held-out AUROC 0.877; a 12-feature logistic model reaches 0.882 [0.845, 0.917] with PR-AUC 0.661, and an untuned random forest on the same decision-time features reaches 0.902 [0.875, 0.928] with PR-AUC 0.701. At a 33.3% held-out replay budget, the logistic and random-forest models recover 81.2% and 82.9% of conflicts, respectively. Patch reconstruction succeeds for 48/79 zero-overlap conflicts and all 48 become clean; the other 31 cases are inconclusive, so this check validates the expected three-way-merge explanation rather than claiming a new Git mechanism. In T1, a zero-shot LLM reaches AUC 0.704 and LLM-plus-metadata fusion 0.740. In T3, a decision-time gate de-overlaps a median 91.7% of labeled scope collisions at 65.0% makespan inflation under frozen-label replay. Because local git merge-tree replay is already cheap in our logs (median 0.02 s), we do not claim that lineage triage saves this checker alone: when exact replay is cheap, verify everything. All empirical guarantees in this paper remain limited to textual mergeability or the explicitly stated frozen-label scheduling target.
paragraphs.zh: 并发式 AI 编码智能体产生了一个协调问题：廉价信号可能会优先处理工作，但只有可执行检查器才能验证所声称的属性。 我们通过一个属性范围的验证合同以及 MergeGym 来研究这种分离；MergeGym 是一个三轨基准测试，用于开放时间范围的预测、重播条件下的冲突解决和调度。 在一个分层化的 715 对谱系集合（包含 167 个文本冲突）中，尽管作者的文件集互不重叠，仍有 79 个冲突（47.3%）出现。 这是一个在操作层面重要的代理匹配问题，也是三向合并所预期的结果：作者提交的 PR 差异是相对于特定 PR 的基线来测量的，而检查器则比较两个头与其共同的合并基线。 一个独立的谱系联合规则在保留集上的 AUROC 达到 0.877；一个包含 12 个特征的逻辑回归模型达到 0.882 [0.845, 0.917]，PR-AUC 为 0.661；而使用相同决策时间特征的未经调优随机森林模型则达到 0.902 [0.875, 0.928]，PR-AUC 为 0.701。 在保留 33.3% 的重播预算时，逻辑回归和随机森林模型分别恢复了 81.2% 和 82.9% 的冲突。 对于 48/79 个零重叠冲突，补丁重构成功，且这 48 个冲突均被清理；其余 31 个案例结果不明确，因此该检查验证了预期的三向合并解释，而非声称发现了新的 Git 机制。 在 T1 中，一个零样本 LLM 的 AUC 达到 0.704，而 LLM 与元数据融合模型的 AUC 达到 0.740。 在 T3 中，一个决策时间门控在冻结标签重播条件下，使标记范围冲突的中位数去重叠率达到了 91.7%，同时使总耗时仅增加 65.0%。 由于在我们的日志中本地 git 合并树重播本身成本很低（中位数为 0.02 秒），我们并不声称谱系分类本身就能节省检查器的时间：当精确重播成本很低时，应验证所有内容。 本文中的所有经验性保证均仅限于文本可合并性或明确声明的冻结标签调度目标。

paragraphs.en: Modern coding agents can open, modify, test, and submit pull requests without waiting for a human developer. Once several agents operate on the same repository, reliability becomes a property of interacting work , not merely of individually plausible patches. With k k concurrent PRs, a coordinator may face k ⁡ ( k − 1 ) / 2 k(k-1)/2 pairwise interactions before considering higher-order effects. Two PRs can edit the same file, duplicate the same task in different files, silently invalidate one another through branch history, or merge textually while breaking build or semantic invariants.

paragraphs.en: This is naturally a verifier-in-the-loop problem. A learned score is useful only if its role is separated from the property it cannot certify. In our setting, git merge-tree deterministically evaluates one narrow predicate: whether two fixed Git heads admit a textual three-way merge from their common base. It does not certify compilation, tests, semantic equivalence, security, or user intent. That narrowness is useful because it gives us a clean trusted boundary: prediction may decide what to check first ; the checker decides the textual property itself.

paragraphs.en: We study one systems question across three empirical scales: how should concurrent coding-agent workflows separate cheap coordination signals from authoritative checks? Population measurements establish that co-active agent work is already common. MergeGym then decomposes pairwise coordination into stage-specific tasks instead of collapsing scope, merge outcome, resolution quality, and scheduling into one generic “conflict” label. Finally, a replay-labeled lineage study quantifies a specific proxy mismatch: authored-file overlap is computed from each PR against its own base, whereas a head-to-head three-way merge is defined relative to the two-head common base. Branch history can therefore make two disjoint authored diffs conflict. This behavior follows from Git semantics; our contribution is to measure how often it matters in agent-PR coordination and how much decision-time lineage state improves held-out ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个经验尺度上研究一个系统问题：并发编码智能体工作流程应如何将廉价的协调信号与权威检查区分开来？ 群体测量表明，智能体协同工作已经十分普遍。 MergeGym 随后将成对协调分解为特定阶段的任务，而不是将作用范围、合并结果、解决质量和调度归为一个泛化的“冲突”标签。 最后，一项带有重播标签的谱系研究量化了一种特定的代理不匹配：通过每个 PR 与其自身基线计算已创建文件的重叠度，而直接三向合并则是相对于两个分支的共同基线定义的。 因此，分支历史可能导致两个互不相关的已创建差异产生冲突。 这种行为源于 Git 的语义；我们的贡献在于衡量它在智能体-PR 协调中出现的频率，以及决策时段的谱系状态在多大程度上能提升预测排名。

paragraphs.en: Prior work on the curated 33,596-PR AIDev-pop subset reports that 26,691 PRs (79.4%) are open concurrently with another agent PR and that 1,129 of 2,807 repositories (40.2%) exhibit such activity [ 1 ] . The 747-pair replay sample used downstream was deliberately stratified: cross-agent pairs are 115/716 evaluable replays (16.1%), far above their population share, so pooled replay rates are sample-conditioned , not population estimates.

paragraphs.en: In that stratified replay, 48/115 cross-agent pairs conflict textually (41.7%) versus 119/601 same-agent pairs (19.8%). A same-repository matched sensitivity materially weakens the interpretation: among 60 repositories with an evaluable pair in both strata, same-agent conflict is 17/60 (28.3%) and cross-agent conflict 26/60 (43.3%); the exact McNemar test has p = 0.078 p=0.078 (15 cross-only versus 6 same-only discordant pairs). A composition check based on agent-specific intra-agent rates expects 37.4% cross-agent conflict versus the observed 41.7%. We therefore do not claim a cross-vendor penalty. The reliable conclusion for this paper is narrower: concurrent pairwise checking is common enough to motivate an explicit coordination layer, while agent-family effects require larger matched replay.

paragraphs.en: T1 asks whether two open PRs will eventually share an authored file, using only information available at open time: title, body, timing, and optional repository metadata. Training contains 24,283 pairs from 870 repositories; the frozen test set contains 5,387 pairs from 229 repositories, all held out by repository, and is 39.93% positive after enrichment. The released baseline ladder includes both classical and language-model baselines. Title Jaccard reaches pooled AUC 0.629, TF–IDF cosine 0.644, a repository-held-out logistic model 0.644 pooled / 0.684 within-repository, and a four-feature out-of-fold fusion 0.676. A zero-shot LLM reaches 0.704, and LLM plus all open-time features reaches 0.740 under five-fold out-of-fold fusion. T1 is therefore a useful planning heuristic , not a verification result, and these numbers should not be read as saturating the task.
paragraphs.zh: T1 询问两个已打开的 PR 最终是否会共享一个作者文件，且仅使用在打开时可获得的信息：标题、内容、时间以及可选的仓库元数据。 训练集包含来自 870 个仓库的 24,283 对数据；冻结测试集包含来自 229 个仓库的 5,387 对数据，所有数据均按仓库划分保留，并在增强后达到 39.93% 的正例率。 发布的基准模型阶梯既包括经典基准模型，也包括语言模型基准模型。 标题 Jaccard 指数达到合并 AUC 0.629，TF–IDF 余弦相似度为 0.644，按仓库划分的逻辑回归模型在合并时达到 0.644、仓库内部达到 0.684，而四特征 out-of-fold 融合模型则达到 0.676。 零样本 LLM 的准确率可达 0.704，而 LLM 结合所有打开时的特征在五次 out-of-fold 融合下的准确率达到 0.740。 因此，T1 是一个有用的规划启发式方法，而非验证结果，这些数值不应被解读为已完全解决该任务。

paragraphs.en: A 162-conflict core pilot extracts 1,635 hunks, 1,469 of which can be located in the reconciliation. Choosing the later PR side exactly matches 49.6% of locatable hunks, the earlier side 28.4%, and union 12.8%. A best-of-these-trivial-strategies oracle reaches 76.2%, leaving 23.8% that require behavior beyond these trivial choices. The individual exact-match percentages sum to 90.8% because their success sets overlap (for some hunks more than one trivial candidate equals the observed reconciliation); 76.2% is the union of those success indicators, not their sum. paragraphs.en: For each of the 79 zero-overlap conflicts we attempt to reconstruct both PR-authored patches on clean branches rooted at the two-head merge base and rerun git merge-tree . Forty-eight pairs are reconstructable and all 48 become clean; none remain conflicting. The remaining 31 are inconclusive: 12 patches conflict while being applied to the reconstruction base, 7 reference paths absent from that base, 1 hits binary-patch/index limitations, 2 fail during clone/network retrieval, and 9 have other patch-application failures. Because disjoint authored patches reconstructed on a common base are expected to merge cleanly, this experiment is best interpreted as a pipeline validation of the proxy-mismatch explanation , not a discovery of a hidden causal mechanism.

paragraphs.en: Operationally, AUROC is secondary to how many failures a fixed replay budget surfaces. On the 497-pair held-out test, Lineage-LR recovers 32.5%, 58.1%, 81.2%, and 96.6% of the 117 conflicts after replaying the top 10%, 20%, 33.3%, and 50% of pairs, respectively; precision at those budgets is 76.0%, 68.0%, 57.2%, and 45.4%. The untuned random forest recovers 32.5%, 57.3%, 82.9%, and 96.6% at the same budgets. The held-out logistic model has Brier score 0.113 [0.096, 0.132], so the evaluation reports calibration as well as ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 从操作层面来看，AUROC 的重要性次于固定重播预算能够揭示的失败数量。 在包含 497 对数据的保留测试集上，Lineage-LR 在分别重播前 10%、20%、33.3% 和 50% 的数据对后，成功恢复了 117 个冲突中的 32.5%、58.1%、81.2% 和 96.6%；在这些预算下的精确度分别为 76.0%、68.0%、57.2% 和 45.4%。 未经调优的随机森林在相同预算下分别恢复了 32.5%、57.3%、82.9% 和 96.6%。 保留测试集中的逻辑回归模型具有 0.113 [0.096, 0.132] 的布里尔得分，因此评估报告同时包含了校准度和排序效果。

paragraphs.en: The cost interpretation is deliberately narrow. The released T2 replay logs contain 5,940 timing records: local three-way replay has median runtime 0.02 s, 90th percentile 0.38 s, and 95th percentile 0.50 s. Lineage feature collection itself can require remote compare metadata, and the original crawl did not record end-to-end feature-fetch timing. Therefore this paper does not demonstrate that predicting before git merge-tree is cheaper than simply running git merge-tree . If local textual replay is available and cheap, verify every pair and discard the predictor. Triage becomes relevant only when the authoritative chain is costlier (e.g., checkout/build/test/specification checks), rate-limited, remote, or queued behind other verifier work.

paragraphs.en: where the corresponding backends might be Git merge replay, a compiler/static analyzer, an executable test suite, and a model checker, SMT solver, proof assistant, or equivalence checker. Passing an earlier predicate is never silently promoted into evidence for a later one. Learned models can propose repairs, invariants, schedules, or promising proof obligations, but each claim remains attached to the backend that checks it. This makes the trust boundary auditable: a failure of the heuristic can waste verifier effort or latency, but it cannot by itself upgrade an unchecked pair into a certified one.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，相应的后端可能包括 Git 合并重放、编译器/静态分析器、可执行测试套件，以及模型检查器、SMT 求解器、证明辅助工具或等价性检查器。 传递一个较早的谓词绝不会悄无声息地成为后续谓词的证据。 学习到的模型可以提出修复方案、不变量、调度计划或有希望的证明义务，但每一项主张仍然与负责验证它的后端相关联。 这使得信任边界具有可审计性：启发式方法的失败可能会浪费验证者的努力或增加延迟，但它本身无法将未经检查的组合升级为经过认证的组合。

paragraphs.en: Agentic software engineering introduces a different throughput regime. AIDev provides a large observational substrate for coding-agent activity [ 2 ] ; AgenticFlict measures conflicts involving agent-authored PRs [ 3 ] ; SWE-bench evaluates isolated issue resolution against executable tests [ 12 ] . CooperBench and BulkPR-Bench move toward interacting or queue-level agent evaluation [ 13 ; 14 ] . Our contribution is complementary: we connect in-the-wild pairwise measurement to an explicit verifier-in-the-loop contract, distinguish observable scope from executable conflict, and show that asymmetric repository lineage materially improves which exact checks should run first.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体驱动的软件工程引入了一种不同的吞吐量模式。 AIDev 为编码智能体的活动提供了丰富的观察基础 [ 2 ]；AgenticFlict 衡量由智能体撰写的 PR 所引发的冲突 [ 3 ]；SWE-bench 则通过可执行测试来评估孤立问题的解决过程 [ 12 ]。 CooperBench 和 BulkPR-Bench 正朝着对互动型或队列级智能体的评估方向迈进 [ 13 ; 14 ]。 我们的贡献具有补充性：我们将实际场景中的成对测量与明确的验证器循环合同相连接，区分了可观察范围与可执行冲突，并证明了非对称的仓库谱系能显著提升哪些具体检查应优先执行。

sents.en: AIDev provides a large observational substrate for coding-agent activity [ 2 ] ; AgenticFlict measures conflicts involving agent-authored PRs [ 3 ] ; SWE-bench evaluates isolated issue resolution against executable tests [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: AIDev 为编码智能体的活动提供了丰富的观察基础 [ 2 ]；AgenticFlict 衡量由智能体撰写的 PR 所引发的冲突 [ 3 ]；SWE-bench 则通过可执行测试来评估孤立问题的解决过程 [ 12 ]。

sents.en: CooperBench and BulkPR-Bench move toward interacting or queue-level agent evaluation [ 13 ; 14 ] .
sents.zh: CooperBench 和 BulkPR-Bench 正朝着对互动型或队列级智能体的评估方向迈进 [ 13 ; 14 ]。

sents.en: Our contribution is complementary: we connect in-the-wild pairwise measurement to an explicit verifier-in-the-loop contract, distinguish observable scope from executable conflict, and show that asymmetric repository lineage materially improves which exact checks should run first.
sents.zh: 我们的贡献具有补充性：我们将实际场景中的成对测量与明确的验证器循环合同相连接，区分了可观察范围与可执行冲突，并证明了非对称的仓库谱系能显著提升哪些具体检查应优先执行。

paragraphs.en: Textual property only. git merge-tree establishes Git’s textual merge outcome for fixed heads and a merge base. CLEAN does not imply build success, passing tests, semantic compatibility, security, or alignment with user intent. Section 7 is a design implication, not an evaluated stronger-verifier result.
paragraphs.zh: 仅涉及文本属性。git merge-tree 为固定的分支头和合并基线确立了 Git 的文本合并结果。 CLEAN 并不意味着构建成功、测试通过、语义兼容、安全或符合用户意图。 第 7 节是一项设计推论，而非经过评估的更强验证器结果。

paragraphs.en: Small, stratified lineage evaluation. The primary predictive test has 497 pairs and 117 conflicts. The 715-pair lineage set intentionally over-samples cross-agent pairs and is not population-representative. AUROC/PR-AUC are therefore held-out performance on this evaluation distribution, not prevalence or deployment-value estimates.
paragraphs.zh: 小型分层谱系评估。 主要预测测试包含 497 对和 117 处冲突。 这个包含 715 对的谱系集有意过度采样跨智能体配对，因此不能代表总体分布。 因此，AUROC/PR-AUC 是在此评估分布上的保留集性能指标，而非流行率或部署价值的估计值。

paragraphs.en: Model headroom remains. A simple lineage-union rule reaches AUROC 0.877 and an untuned random forest reaches 0.902, exceeding the transparent logistic model’s 0.882. We therefore claim that lineage state is useful, not that Lineage-LR is close to the strongest achievable predictor under the same information constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 模型仍有提升空间。 一个简单的谱系联合规则达到了 AUROC 0.877，而未调优的随机森林则达到了 0.902，均超过了透明逻辑回归模型的 0.882。 因此，我们认为谱系状态是有用的，但这并不意味着 Lineage-LR 在相同信息约束下接近最强可实现的预测模型。

paragraphs.en: Repository, language, and agent concentration. Thirty alternative 30/70 repository-held-out splits give median full-model AUROC 0.876 (IQR 0.865–0.885; range 0.829–0.901). Leave-one-agent-family-out AUROCs range 0.845–0.901 across the five represented agent families; leave-one-language-out AUROCs over the six languages with at least 40 pairs range 0.835–0.950. These checks reduce but do not remove external-validity concerns, especially for repositories and agent families absent from AIDev-pop.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库、语言和智能体浓度。 三十种替代的 30/70 仓库保留划分得到的完整模型 AUROC 中位数为 0.876（IQR 0.865–0.885；范围 0.829–0.901）。 在五种已表示的智能体家族中，每留出一个智能体家族的 AUROC 范围是 0.845–0.901；在至少包含 40 对数据的六种语言中，每留出一个语言的 AUROC 范围是 0.835–0.950。 这些检验虽能减轻外部效度方面的担忧，但并未完全消除，尤其是对于 AIDev-pop 中未包含的仓库和智能体家族而言。

paragraphs.en: Lineage availability. One of 715 pairs lacks lineage retrieval and 60/714 retrieved rows are marked truncated by the compare-data path; 44 truncated-or-missing rows fall in the held-out test. On the 453 untruncated test rows, AUROC is 0.904. A conservative stress test that zeros lineage features for truncated/missing test rows lowers full-model AUROC from 0.882 to 0.791 and PR-AUC from 0.661 to 0.574. A deployment should therefore fall back to exact verification when lineage metadata is incomplete rather than treating missing state as evidence of safety.
paragraphs.zh: 谱系可用性。 在 715 对数据中，有一对无法获取谱系信息；而在成功获取的 714 行数据中，有 60 行被 compare-data 路径标记为截断；其中 44 行属于截断或缺失的行，并落入预留的测试集。 在 453 行未截断的测试数据上，AUROC 为 0.904。 一种保守的压力测试方法：对于截断或缺失的测试行，将谱系特征置零，这会使完整模型的 AUROC 从 0.882 降至 0.791，PR-AUC 从 0.661 降至 0.574。 因此，在部署时，当谱系元数据不完整时，系统应回退到精确验证，而不是将缺失的状态视为安全的证据。

paragraphs.en: Pairwise versus staleness. The frozen data do not preserve the contemporaneous default-branch tip needed to test whether each PR independently conflicts with mainline. The zero-overlap result is thus framed as a head-to-head proxy mismatch, not proof that every case is uniquely caused by interaction between the two PRs.
paragraphs.zh: 成对比较与陈旧性。 冻结的数据并未保留当前默认分支的尖端状态，而这一状态是检验每个拉取请求是否独立与主分支冲突所必需的。 因此，零重叠的结果被界定为一种直接对比中的代理不匹配，而非证明每个案例都完全由两个拉取请求之间的相互作用所导致。

paragraphs.en: Scheduling replay. MergeGym T3 freezes historical labels, keeps durations fixed, and assumes agents do not react to delay. Its frontier is a scheduling-feasibility analysis, not a causal deployment trial. Bootstrap intervals quantify episode heterogeneity but do not repair this counterfactual limitation.
paragraphs.zh: 安排重播。 MergeGym T3 会冻结历史标签，保持持续时间固定，并假设智能体不会对延迟做出反应。 其前沿是调度可行性分析，而非因果部署试验。 Bootstrap 区间可以量化回合的异质性，但无法修复这种反事实局限性。

paragraphs.zh: 验证器成本。 在已发布的时序日志中，本地文本重播的成本已经非常低，且谱系获取成本并未被一致地记录。 我们仅针对 git merge-tree 分类处理本身，并不声称能节省净计算资源。

paragraphs.en: Code provenance and licensing. Source-repository licenses govern code originating from those repositories. The released supplement excludes the raw T2 hunk-text bundle pending repository-by-repository redistribution clearance and retains only derived labels/metrics plus scripts and identifiers needed to reconstruct hunks from upstream sources where permitted. This licensing constraint is distinct from scientific reproducibility and remains explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 代码来源与许可。 源仓库的许可证适用于源自这些仓库的代码。 已发布的补充材料排除了原始的 T2 hunk-text 包，因为尚需逐个仓库获得重新分发的许可；其中仅保留了派生标签/指标，以及在允许的情况下用于从上游源重建 hunks 所需的脚本和标识符。 这一许可限制与科学可重复性无关，且始终明确存在。

paragraphs.en: Potential impact and misuse. Low heuristic scores must never be treated as permission to skip a checker whose property is required. The mitigation is architectural: scores may prioritize or delay checks, but guarantees come only from the corresponding executable backend.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在影响与滥用。 绝不能将低启发式分数视为跳过某个属性为必需的检查器的许可。 缓解措施属于架构层面：分数可以优先执行或延迟检查，但保障只能来自相应的可执行后端。

paragraphs.en: Concurrent coding agents create a verification-orchestration problem: cheap scope proxies can be useful for planning, but they are not interchangeable with executable checks. In the stratified lineage set, 47.3% of replay-confirmed textual conflicts occur despite disjoint authored file sets because authored PR diffs and the diff used by a two-head three-way merge are different objects. The contribution is the measured prevalence and operational consequence of that proxy mismatch, not a new Git mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 并发编码智能体会产生一个验证协调问题：廉价的范围代理可用于规划，但它们与可执行检查并非相互替换。 在分层谱系集中，47.3% 的重播确认文本冲突发生在作者文件集互不重叠的情况下，这是因为已提交的 PR 差异与双头三路合并所使用的差异属于不同的对象。 本研究的贡献在于量化了这种代理失配现象的普遍性及其运行影响，而非提出一种新的 Git 机制。

paragraphs.en: Decision-time lineage state substantially improves held-out prioritization. A standalone lineage-union rule reaches AUROC 0.877, the transparent logistic model 0.882 with PR-AUC 0.661, and an untuned random forest on the same 12 features 0.902 with PR-AUC 0.701. At a 33.3% replay budget the learned models recover roughly 81–83% of held-out conflicts. The correct systems principle remains: heuristics should schedule guarantees, not impersonate them . When the checker is cheap, run it on everything; when a stronger verifier chain is expensive or constrained, use predictions only to order work while leaving the executable backend in charge of the claim.
paragraphs.zh: 决策时段的谱系状态显著提升了保留数据的优先级排序效果。 独立的谱系联合规则达到 AUROC 0.877，透明逻辑模型为 0.882（PR-AUC 为 0.661），而基于相同 12 个特征但未调优的随机森林则达到 0.902（PR-AUC 为 0.701）。 在 33.3% 的重播预算下，学习到的模型能够恢复保留冲突中约 81–83% 的情况。 正确的系统原则依然成立：启发式方法应安排保障机制，而非冒充保障机制本身。 当检查器成本较低时，应对所有数据运行检查；而当更强大的验证链成本高昂或受限制时，仅使用预测结果来排序任务，同时让可执行的后台组件负责验证声明。

sents.zh: 决策时段的谱系状态显著提升了保留数据的优先级排序效果。

paragraphs.en: All analyses in this appendix use the frozen released row-level artifact; no outcome is imputed and no test labels are used for model fitting.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录中的所有分析均使用已冻结的、已发布的行级数据产物；未对任何结果进行推断，也未使用任何测试标签进行模型拟合。

paragraphs.en: Population, replay-rate, zero-overlap, and patch-reconstruction numbers are descriptive characterizations of their stated samples. T1 and lineage AUROC/PR-AUC/budget results are predictive evaluations on repository-held-out data. T3 numbers are frozen-label scheduling simulations. None of the descriptive rates are presented as population prevalence unless explicitly inherited from the prior AIDev-pop measurement in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 人口、重播率、零重叠和补丁重建数值是对所声明样本的描述性特征。 T1 以及谱系 AUROC/PR-AUC/预算结果是对存储库中预留数据进行的预测性评估。 T3 数值是固定标签调度模拟的结果。 除非明确继承自表 1 中先前的 AIDev-pop 测量值，否则任何描述性比率都不会被呈现为人口流行率。

sents.zh: 人口、重播率、零重叠和补丁重建数值是对所声明样本的描述性特征。

sents.en: T1 and lineage AUROC/PR-AUC/budget results are predictive evaluations on repository-held-out data.

paragraphs.en: We refit logistic regression on the same deterministic repository split using nested decision-time feature groups. “Overlap-only” uses overlap count, Jaccard, and directory overlap; “metadata-only” adds the deterministic risk score; “lineage-only” uses OneSidedTouch , lineage-union overlap, two behind-base indicators, two base-churn counts, and two branch ages; “full” is the 12-feature model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用嵌套决策时间特征组，对相同的确定性存储库划分重新拟合了逻辑回归模型。“仅重叠”模型使用重叠次数、Jaccard指数和目录重叠；“仅元数据”模型在此基础上增加了确定性风险评分；“仅谱系”模型使用OneSidedTouch、谱系并集重叠、两个base之后的指示器、两个base-churn计数以及两个分支年龄；“完整”模型则是包含12个特征的全模型。

paragraphs.en: Lineage is missing for 1/715 pairs; 60/714 retrieved rows carry a truncation flag, including 44 held-out rows. Evaluating only the 453 held-out rows without missing/truncated lineage gives AUROC 0.904. Conservatively zeroing all eight lineage features for truncated/missing held-out rows reduces full-model AUROC to 0.791 and PR-AUC to 0.574. This motivates an explicit deployment fallback to the exact checker.
paragraphs.zh: 有 1/715 对缺少谱系信息；检索到的 60/714 行带有截断标志，其中包括 44 行保留行。 仅评估没有缺失或截断谱系的 453 行保留行，得到的 AUROC 为 0.904。 保守地将所有截断或缺失谱系的保留行的八项谱系特征置零后，完整模型的 AUROC 降至 0.791，PR-AUC 降至 0.574。 这促使我们明确部署一个回退方案，即使用精确检查器。

paragraphs.en: Eight of the 11 OneSidedTouch false negatives carry truncated lineage metadata. Under the retrieved metadata, 10/11 also have zero lineage-union overlap; the remaining case has lineage-union overlap but no one-sided authored-path intersection and contains multiple conflict types. None of the 11 is labeled as a rename conflict in the replay output. Thus the misses are dominated by unavailable/incomplete lineage state or by conflict structure not captured by the one-sided authored-path predicate, rather than a single rename pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 在 11 个 OneSidedTouch 假阴性中，有 8 个携带了截断的谱系元数据。 在检索到的元数据中，10/11 个案例的谱系并集重叠也为零；剩余一个案例虽有谱系并集重叠，但无单侧作者路径交集，且包含多种冲突类型。 在重播输出中，这 11 个案例均未被标记为重命名冲突。 因此，这些漏检主要由不可用或不完整的谱系状态，或未被单侧作者路径谓词捕捉到的冲突结构所导致，而非单一的重命名模式所致。

paragraphs.en: Repositories are deterministically hashed into dev (218 pairs, 50 conflicts) and test (497 pairs, 117 conflicts). Numeric lineage-model features are standardized on dev; model fitting and operating-threshold selection use dev only. Test AUROC confidence intervals use 2,000 bootstrap resamples with seed 0. The file-list LLM baseline is Claude Haiku 4.5; its prompt contains the repository identifier, each PR’s authored paths (capped at 150 per side with truncation marked), and a request for a conflict verdict, confidence, and short rationale. It receives no merge result, conflicted path, conflict type, or lineage variable.

paragraphs.en: Some operations are intrinsically time-sensitive. Replaying Git heads requires public refs that may later disappear, and rerunning the external LLM baseline requires model access. The artifact therefore ships the frozen replay/LLM outputs used by the paper together with their manifests and verification scripts. This makes the reported analysis reproducible even if an upstream PR ref or hosted model later becomes unavailable, while still providing the live-fetch code for independent replication. T2 records 447 unavailable pairs and four missing refs in the full candidate set instead of imputing outcomes. The lineage package similarly keeps 31 failed patch reconstructions as inconclusive rather than folding them into either ablation result.
paragraphs.zh: 某些操作本质上具有时间敏感性。 重新运行 Git 头部需要公共引用，而这些引用可能随后消失；重新运行外部 LLM 基线则需要模型访问权限。 因此，该成果随附了论文中使用的冻结版重演/LLM 输出，以及它们对应的清单和验证脚本。 这样一来，即使上游 PR 引用或托管模型后来无法使用，所报告的分析结果仍然可复现，同时仍提供了实时获取代码以实现独立复制。 T2 在完整的候选集中记录了 447 个不可用的配对和 4 个缺失的引用，而不是对结果进行推断。 谱系包同样将 31 个失败的补丁重建保留为结论不明的状态，而非将其归入任何消融分析结果中。

paragraphs.en: The released code is CPU-oriented: Git replay, Pandas/NumPy/SciPy/statistical routines, scikit-learn-style linear models, and plotting; no GPU training is required for the proposed method. The population package provides a Dockerfile, pinned Python 3.12.8 image path for its containerized workflow, a recorded local Git/Python environment, and stage-level runtime guidance (offline analysis and figures are minute-scale; live replay is hours-scale). The MergeGym artifact provides a Python dependency lockfile and the lineage package provides its minimal requirements. Historical peak memory and wall-clock accounting were not captured consistently across all three original development environments, so we make no precise peak-memory or total-compute claim on that point.
